method: Every reachable source commit reviewed once, weight=1; one primary category per nonmerge commit, merges counted separately. Dates, churn, author and recency do not alter weight. PR association uses merge-first-parent..merge-second-parent reachability (earliest merged PR wins), not title guessing.
